links.outcome: Sensitivity of dermoscopy-trained CNN on close-up images, a setting it was not validated for
links.effect: Sensitivity fell from 88.2% (dermoscopic) to 60.5% (close-up, p < 0.001); specificity rose from 69.0% to 79.4% (p = 0.027); ROC-AUC 0.866 vs 0.780 (p = 0.003).
links.quote: For close-up images of the same lesions, sensitivity decreased to 60.5% (53.5%-67.1%, p < 0.001), while specificity increased to 79.4% (72.3%-85.0%, p = 0.027).

screen.reason: Evaluates the robustness/domain shift of a commercial dermoscopy CNN when tested on clinical close-up images, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
